commits.message:
Add routed expert loading for gpt-oss (#52209)

Signed-off-by: Wyett <wyettzeng@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: wyett <wyettzeng@gmail.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/fused_moe.py — AscendMoERunner (depends on routed_experts.quant_type / .forward_impl / EPLB & expert-map state)
vllm_ascend/utils.py — REGISTERED_ASCEND_OPS / CustomOp.register_oot registration for RoutedExperts and MoERunner
vllm_ascend/distributed/weight_transfer/hccl_engine.py — uses upstream layerwise reload (initialize/finalize_layerwise_reload) affected by the reload/meta.py change (low risk)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Root cause: the commit makes gpt-oss pass `routed_experts_cls=GptOssRoutedExperts` to FusedMoEFactory (vllm/model_executor/models/gpt_oss.py MLPBlock). GptOssRoutedExperts subclasses RoutedExperts, and vLLM's PluggableLayer.__new__ substitutes the OOT class ONLY by exact class name against op_registry_oot (vllm/model_executor/custom_op.py:47-66). vllm-ascend registers "RoutedExperts"→AscendRoutedExperts and "MoERunner"→AscendMoERunner, but NOT "GptOssRoutedExperts", so on NPU the plain upstream class is instantiated and AscendRoutedExperts is bypassed. AscendMoERunner then accesses routed_experts.quant_type (fused_moe.py:70) and calls routed_experts.forward_impl(...) (fused_moe.py:218/239/272/297); the plain upstream RoutedExperts/GptOssRoutedExperts defines neither (verified: no forward_impl, no quant_type), so gpt-oss on Ascend fails with AttributeError at model construction/forward. Adaptation required: (1) add an Ascend subclass of GptOssRoutedExperts (e.g. AscendGptOssRoutedExperts in vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/routed_experts.py) that re-implements the same overrides as AscendRoutedExperts (__init__ installing AscendUnquantizedFusedMoEMethod, _get_quant_method with tid2eid, forward_impl returning routed_out(+FusedMoEEvents), update_expert_map, quant_type, EPLB/expert-map/ascend_expert_map plumbing); (2) register it in REGISTERED_ASCEND_OPS in vllm_ascend/utils.py as "GptOssRoutedExperts" (and "GptOssRoutedExperts310" in the _310p block for 310P); (3) validate the new streamed per-expert weight loading path (GptOssModel._try_load_streamed_expert/_get_streamed_expert_info and GptOssRoutedExperts.weight_loader, including _map_global_expert_id_to_local_expert_id and EPLB global→local mapping) on NPU, since gpt-oss weight loading now goes through GptOssRoutedExperts.weight_loader instead of the Ascend layer; (4) run the existing gpt-oss e2e (tests/e2e/pull_request/two_card/test_gpt_oss_distributed.py, unsloth/gpt-oss-20b-BF16, TP2) to confirm. The reload/meta.py restore_layer_on_meta change (union of tensor names + hasattr guard) is backwards-compatible and used via the upstream layerwise reload that vllm-ascend's HCCL weight transfer relies on; no interface change needed there, but it should be covered by sleep/wake + weight-transfer regression tests.
deep_analysis.risk: High for gpt-oss on Ascend if not adapted: model construction crashes (routed_experts.quant_type AttributeError in AscendMoERunner.__init__) and, even past that, forward crashes on routed_experts.forward_impl, silently losing the Ascend MoE kernel/EPLB/expert-map execution path and the AscendUnquantizedFusedMoEMethod. The bypass is silent (no error at weight load), so it could also produce wrong outputs or fall back to non-NPU execution if a caller catches the AttributeError. The new streamed/individual-expert checkpoint path is fresh and must be validated with Ascend weight sharding (TP/EP) and level-2 sleep/wake layerwise reload. reload/meta.py change is low risk. Overall: medium-high.

commits.message:
[Model] Add Qwen3-Omni DSpark support (#52560)

Signed-off-by: Zhou248 <630563665@qq.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/models/qwen3_dspark.py::AscendQwen3DSparkForCausalLM — directly subclasses upstream vllm.model_executor.models.qwen3_dspark.Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM, whose __init__ (new self.target_vocab_size attribute) and load_weights (new ValueError validations for expanded/reduced-vocab checkpoints) are modified

vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_dspark.py::_load_dspark_model_with_target_quant — monkey-patches vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dspark.utils.load_dspark_model, which is modified (new vocab-size guards before sharing embed_tokens/lm_head)

vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_speculative_config.py::_dspark_post_init — monkey-patches SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__, which gains ~300 lines of new Qwen3-Omni DSpark validation (_validate_qwen3_omni_dspark) and Qwen3OmniDSparkModel branches
vllm_ascend/models/__init__.py::ModelRegistry — upstream registers new Qwen3OmniDSparkModel architecture; vllm-ascend does not register it, so the new feature is unavailable on NPU without adaptation

vllm_ascend/spec_decode/dspark_proposer.py::AscendDSparkProposer and vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dspark/speculator.py::AscendDSparkSpeculator — depend on upstream DSparkSpeculator and on sample_from_anchor/dspark_bonus_anchor hf-config semantics, which update_dspark in vllm/transformers_utils/configs/speculators/algos.py now rewrites
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
The commit is largely additive (new Qwen3-Omni DSpark model + config validation) and backward-compatible for standard equal-vocab DSpark drafts, but it touches shared DSpark code that vllm-ascend subclasses and patches, so it must be validated and the new architecture wired up:

1. vllm_ascend/models/qwen3_dspark.py (AscendQwen3DSparkForCausalLM): re-verify against the modified base Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM. New __init__ stores self.target_vocab_size; new load_weights validations raise ValueError when uses_expanded_input_vocab (config.vocab_size > target) without embed_tokens, or uses_reduced_vocab (draft_vocab_size != target) without lm_head / draft_id_to_target_id. For released Qwen3DSpark checkpoints with equal vocab these do not fire; run the existing tests/ut/model_executor/test_qwen3_dspark.py to confirm no new failures.

2. vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_dspark.py (_load_dspark_model_with_target_quant): upstream load_dspark_model now only aliases embed_tokens when draft_model_config.get_vocab_size() <= target_vocab_size and lm_head only when draft_vocab_size == target_vocab_size. Equal-vocab drafts (Qwen3DSpark, DeepSeek-V4 same-checkpoint) satisfy both; regression-test same-checkpoint DeepSeek-V4 DSpark weight loading with W4A8/W8A8 target quant.

3. vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_speculative_config.py (_dspark_post_init): confirm the wrapper still functions against the expanded SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__. The new _validate_qwen3_omni_dspark early-returns for non-Omni targets, so existing DeepSeek-V4/Qwen3 DSpark configs are unaffected; keep the ptd_token_id fallback from dspark_noise_token_id/mask_token_id intact.

4. vllm_ascend/models/__init__.py: to enable the new feature on NPU, register 'Qwen3OmniDSparkModel' -> 'vllm_ascend.models.qwen3_dspark:AscendQwen3DSparkForCausalLM' (or a dedicated subclass), and confirm the Qwen3-Omni target path (upstream qwen3_omni_moe_thinker.py now implements SupportsEagle3 and returns aux hidden states from Qwen3MoeLLMModel.forward) works with the Ascend runner; if vllm-ascend later carries its own Qwen3-Omni implementation, mirror the aux-hidden-state collection + SupportsEagle3 additions.

5. Watch behavior change in vllm/transformers_utils/configs/speculators/algos.py update_dspark: it now sets dspark_bonus_anchor = not sample_from_anchor in the draft hf_config (sample_from_anchor default stays False). Verify AscendDSparkProposer/AscendDSparkSpeculator sampling shape is unchanged for existing checkpoints.
deep_analysis.risk: Low-to-medium. Most changes are additive and backward-compatible for standard equal-vocab DSpark drafts: (a) the new load_weights validations in Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM will now hard-fail checkpoints that previously loaded silently with expanded/reduced vocab and missing embed_tokens/lm_head/d2t mapping; (b) update_dspark's new dspark_bonus_anchor flag (inverse of sample_from_anchor) could subtly change bonus-anchor sampling semantics if hf configs are regenerated; (c) if Qwen3-Omni DSpark is enabled on NPU without registering Qwen3OmniDSparkModel, model loading fails with an unknown-architecture error. The monkey-patched wrappers (patch_speculative_config, patch_dspark) are resilient because they delegate to the originals, but both should be regression-tested against the modified upstream code.

commits.comment: 新增 vllm/model_executor/model_loader/checkpoint_weight_patch.py，支持通过模型原生 load_weights 方法应用稠密或稀疏的 checkpoint 权重更新（RL 场景）。稀疏 patch 使用 NaN 作为"未变更"哨兵值，通过临时替换 torch.Tensor.copy_ 为 copy_non_nan_ 实现原地更新。支持按 max_chunk_bytes 分批调用 load_weights，同一权重名的多个 patch 按输入顺序应用。该模块是新增功能，不修改现有接口，但 monkey-patch torch.Tensor.copy_ 的方式有一定风险（要求 loader 的最终写入必须是同形状浮点 copy_）。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The new feature (internal prefill checkpoints) is fully gated behind MambaSpec.num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks > 0, which only KimiK3DeltaAttention.get_kv_cache_spec sets when kda_prefill_backend == 'flashkda'. is_flashkda_supported() requires current_platform.is_cuda() (vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/kda.py:171-181), so on Ascend it resolves to 'triton' and num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks stays 0. No forced behavior change, but verify these vllm-ascend touchpoints: 1) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_mamba_manager.py - AscendMambaManager.get_num_blocks_to_allocate calls super(); the upstream method now adds checkpoint_block via _needs_internal_checkpoint and stores self._num_checkpoint_blocks (only initialized in the 'align' branch of the new __init__). With num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=0, checkpoint_block=0 and the old/new logic are identical, so the override's extra '+1' for external cache tokens remains correct; keep super().__init__() called so _num_checkpoint_blocks exists. 2) MambaSpec constructions in patch_mamba_config.py / patch_mamba_config_310.py / mooncake connectors / ascend_store use keyword args, so the new default-0 field is backward compatible; leave 0 on Ascend. 3) Custom schedulers (vllm_ascend/core/scheduler_profiling_chunk.py:345, dyntra_lb_scheduler.py:534/898, recompute_scheduler.py:314/701) call _mamba_block_aligned_split(request, num_new_tokens); signature is unchanged and the new use_internal_checkpoint branch is inert because mamba_has_prefill_checkpoint_blocks is False when num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=0 (set in Scheduler.__init__, which these subclasses reach via super()). 4) KDA model path (vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/kda.py, kda_metadata.py) is CUDA/FlashKDA-only; Ascend uses AscendGatedDeltaNetAttention (vllm_ascend/ops/gdn.py) + triton KDA kernels, unaffected. 5) Optional: add a regression test in tests/ut/patch/platform/test_prefix_cache_cp_patches.py asserting AscendMambaManager block counts are unchanged with num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=0.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. The feature is gated behind a field only the CUDA FlashKDA backend sets, so Ascend never enters the new allocation/checkpoint path and no functional regression is expected. Residual risks: (a) AscendMambaManager.get_num_blocks_to_allocate is an override of a method whose block-counting invariants upstream refactored - drift risk if future commits remove the num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=0 fast path; (b) the new assert in allocate_new_blocks (num_new_blocks <= 1 + has_partial_hit + checkpoint_block [+ num_speculative_blocks]) is unchanged at checkpoint_block=0; (c) the FlashKDA C++ signature (csrc/flashkda_registration.cpp) gained optional checkpoint_state/checkpoint_offsets args and the cmake FlashKDA tag was bumped - irrelevant to Ascend since _flashkda_C is not built on NPU.

commits.comment: 移除 BaseMultiModalProcessor 的 renderer_applies_updates 类变量和 _maybe_apply_prompt_updates 的 is_update_applied 参数。所有处理器现在统一走 _apply_prompt_updates 路径。Pixtral 和 Voxtral 通过覆写 _maybe_apply_prompt_updates 实现"仅验证不修改"的行为（因为 token 已由 chat template 插入）。Qwen2.5-Omni 和 Qwen3-Omni 的 use_audio_in_video 逻辑简化。该变更简化了多模态处理流程，但改变了 _maybe_apply_prompt_updates 的方法签名。

ascend_impact.functionality: BaseMultiModalProcessor._maybe_apply_prompt_updates 方法签名移除 is_update_applied 参数，renderer_applies_updates 类变量被删除。vllm-ascend 中任何覆写 _maybe_apply_prompt_updates 或设置 renderer_applies_updates 的自定义多模态处理器需要同步更新。Pixtral/Voxtral 的"仅验证"模式通过覆写方法实现，vllm-ascend 若有类似需求应参考该模式。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 的多模态处理器测试需适配新签名。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend 自定义多模态处理器的 _maybe_apply_prompt_updates 覆写
